title: Help
lead: For when someone is separated from the group.
notFound: This trip wasn't found, or you haven't joined it yet.
offline: No connection. What you do here is sent once you are back online.
offlineOnly: This needs a connection to change.

who.title: Which one are you?
who.hint: Pick yourself, so the group knows who is asking for help and your number is printed on the right card.
who.taken: Someone else already joined as this member.

roll.title: The group
roll.tap: Tap a name to report them missing or see their card. The icons on the right open WhatsApp and a call.

search.title: Looking for {name}
search.planNone: Today's plan has no stop at this hour.
search.noPhoneBody: Call another member who may be with them, or wait for word from someone who reads their card.
search.noNumber: There is no phone number for {name} yet.
search.toldInApp: {name} has been told through Kancara and can answer from their phone.
search.queued: No connection. This report is sent once you are back online.
search.message: The group is waiting at {place}. Contact me right away.
search.messageNoPlace: The group is looking for you. Contact me right away.
search.finderWith: Someone who read their card is with {name}.
search.reportHint: Every member with Kancara open is told.
search.messageLink: Open this link to see the meeting point: {link}

sos.title: Back to the group
sos.queued: No connection. The group is told once you are back online.
sos.asked: The group is looking for you. Answer so they know how you are.
sos.needWho: Pick which member you are first, then Kancara can tell the group.
sos.meetNone: There is no meeting point yet. Call the group leader.
sos.locationOff: Your position can't be read. Turn location on to see the direction and distance.
sos.shareHint: Sent once. Kancara does not track you.
sos.shareFailed: The location can't be read on this phone.
sos.smsBody: This is {name}. I'm separated from the group. Please call me.
sos.noNumbers: No number to call yet. Add members' numbers in the group list.
sos.buttonHint: Pressing this tells the whole group.

contacts.title: Important numbers
contacts.phoneInvalid: This number can't be read yet.
contacts.empty: No local contacts yet. Add the information desk or security of a place you visit.

meeting.title: Meeting point
meeting.name: Place
meeting.notePlaceholder: For example: by the ticket office
meeting.hereHint: Press the button above to use this phone's position. Its name and address fill in by themselves.
meeting.hereFailed: The location can't be read on this phone.
meeting.mapLabel: Map to pick the meeting point
meeting.mapHint: Slide the map until the pin sits on the meeting point. Its name and address fill in by themselves.
meeting.placed: The location is ready to save.
meeting.mapOffline: The map needs a connection. The address above can still be read.
meeting.addressSource: The name and address were filled in from OpenStreetMap. Change them if they are off.

member.phoneHint: Write it with the country code. A number that starts with 0 is read as Indonesian.
member.phoneInvalid: This number can't be read yet. Try it with the country code, for example +62.
member.hasPhone: Carries a phone on the trip
member.linkMessage: This is your help page for {trip}. If you get separated from the group, open it and press "I'm separated": {link}
member.linkHint: {name} only has to open this link. No account needed.

second.title: Second number
second.hint: Printed on every card, to call when the group leader's number doesn't answer.

card.title: {name}'s meeting card
card.needLead: The card needs one number that can be called. Ask the group leader to fill it in.
card.tip: Keep it in the phone's gallery, or print it and tuck it in a pocket, a bag, or a wristband.
card.needNumber: The card needs one number a finder can call. Write the group leader's number and the card is ready.

ready.title: Ready to go

items.reach: Every member who carries a phone is connected or has a number on record
items.cards: Every member without a phone has a saved meeting card
items.second: The second number for the cards is filled in
items.offline: This page is kept on this phone
items.push: Notifications are on for this phone

ready.pushHint: So this phone rings when a member is separated, even with Kancara closed.
ready.pushFailed: Notifications couldn't be turned on. Check your connection, then try again.
ready.pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then reload the page.
ready.pushUnsupported: This browser can't receive notifications yet. On an iPhone, add Kancara to the home screen first.

countries.title: Countries visited
countries.hint: They decide the emergency numbers and the language on the cards.

dock.asking: The group is looking for you
dock.label: Searches for members

join.title: Join {trip}
join.invalid: This invite link no longer works. Ask the group leader for a new one.
join.leadOpen: Pick your name. No account needed.
join.haveAccount: Have a Kancara account? Sign in to join under your own name and hear when someone is separated.
join.asSelfHint: You are in the group right away. The leader doesn't have to add you first.
join.listed: Already added by the group leader? Pick your name
join.emptyOpen: No names on the list yet. Sign in with a Kancara account to join right away.

link.lead: If you get separated from the group, press "I'm separated". The group is told at once and you are shown the way back.
link.keep: Your help page for {trip}. Open it again any time from the same link.
link.notFound: This link no longer works. Ask the group leader for a new one.

call.title: Call {name}
call.hint: This device doesn't place calls itself. Call this number from your phone, or copy it.
call.textHint: This device doesn't send texts itself. Send the message below to this number from your phone.

push.askingTitle: The group is looking for you
push.body: Open Kancara to see the meeting point and reach them.
push.askingBody: Open Kancara and answer so they know how you are.
